name: Vamsi Bonthala
title: Chief Executive Officer, Arbor Lodging Partners
summary: Co-founder and CEO of the investment arm, leading corporate strategy, investor relations, acquisitions, dispositions, and asset management.
bio: Co-founded Arbor Lodging in 2006 and has overseen approximately $1.75B of transaction volume. Prior to Arbor, he practiced law in private equity and real estate at Kirkland & Ellis LLP and Cadwalader, Wickersham & Taft LLP.
prior_background: Private equity and real estate attorney; co-founder and investment CEO

name: Sheenal Patel
title: Co-Founder and CEO, Arbor Lodging Management
summary: Co-founder leading management-company strategy, property management, capital improvements, and human capital.
bio: Before co-founding Arbor, he was a Vice President at Related Capital Company and originated about $800M of tax-exempt bond transactions for LIHTC multifamily projects. He also started his career in leveraged finance at CIBC World Markets.
prior_background: Related Capital Company vice president; leveraged finance at CIBC

name: Jorge Calderon
title: Senior Vice President of Operations
summary: Mexico operations leader with experience across eight countries and more than 20 destinations.
bio: Specializes in hotel openings, operational quality, and efficiency. Previously led hospitality and property-management initiatives across Puerto Rico, Portugal, Colombia, and Panama.
prior_background: Director of Hospitality and Property Management at Lifeafar; Corporate Director of Operations at OxoHotel; Director of Operations at InterContinental Playa Bonita Resort and Spa

name: Jose Duran
title: Human Resources Director
summary: CDMX-based HR director with more than 15 years in hospitality talent and culture.
bio: Has led hotel-opening and culture-transformation initiatives and worked with Starwood, Marriott, and Accor brand ecosystems.
prior_background: Human resources leadership across Starwood, Marriott, and Accor portfolios

name: Christian Hutchinson
title: Director of Business Development, CALA
summary: Leads CALA expansion and hotel-management growth from Mexico City.
bio: Experienced in feasibility, underwriting, and contract execution across the United States, Mexico, Caribbean, and wider LATAM markets, including projects in Peru and Costa Rica.
prior_background: Hospitality business development and deal execution across CALA

name: Valente Ruiz
title: Senior Director of Brand and Communications
summary: Leads brand growth strategy, digital presence, media, and communications initiatives.
bio: Brings more than 20 years of experience across Mexico, the United States, LATAM, and Caribbean markets, including prior marketing and commercial leadership roles in aviation and hospitality.
prior_background: Vice President of Marketing and Sales at Arajet; marketing and customer-attraction leadership at Volaris

name: Adriana Coca
title: Director of Corporate Accounting
summary: Corporate accounting leader with more than 15 years of accounting and cross-border LATAM finance experience.
bio: Previously worked at KKR and the UK Foreign and Commonwealth Office and managed LATAM financial consolidation in hospitality across Mexico, Colombia, Haiti, and Cuba.
prior_background: Finance and accounting leadership at KKR and NH hospitality operations

name: Carlos Orduno
title: Senior Director of Finance and Accounting
summary: CDMX finance leader with more than a decade of hospitality finance and restructuring experience.
bio: Has led finance transformations and diligence processes across Mexico, Caribbean, and United States markets, including prior roles with Hilton and Club Med portfolios.
prior_background: Finance and administration management for all-inclusive Caribbean resort operations; advisory background in tax and transfer pricing

name: Elizabeth Donjuan
title: Area Director of Sales
summary: Sales leader with more than 20 years of hospitality experience across full-service and focus-service hotels.
bio: Has developed sales and marketing strategies across corporate, leisure, tour and travel, and group segments, with experience in hotel openings and established urban and resort properties.
prior_background: Tourism-trained commercial leader with Marriott, Hilton, and Choice brand experience

name: Alicia Cooper
title: Area Director of Sales
summary: Sales executive with more than 15 years of experience across city and beach hotels in national and international markets.
bio: Has led sales for full-service and focus-service hotels across corporate, government, leisure, and group segments with Starwood and Hilton portfolio experience.
prior_background: Director of sales roles in branded full-service and focus-service hotels
